[/size][/center][center][/center][center]﻿I noticed Siv updated her [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/sivs-marriage-mod-now-open-source.109678/]Marriage Mod[/url] (Bless you, great Siv !) and since I've wanted to mod Willy's portrait for a long time, I thought "let's do this !" ! Willy is now younger but not too young either. I wanted him to still give off that mature man look.

I might do the other bachelors / bachelorettes added by Siv's mod.
(Clint, Gus, Lewis, Linus, Marnie, Pam, Sandy and The Wizard)

[size=5]Credits[/size][/center][center]﻿[/center][center]I'd like to thank [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/blooper8484.647414/]Blooper8484[/url] for helping me with the overworld sprites! He did an awesome job!

[/center][center][size=5]New Description﻿[/size]

The old mod was made to use with Siv's Marriage Mod, however you don't need it (at least I didn't need it to use it) You can possibly still download it and use it if you want. Though I don't know if it works currently as it's pretty old.[/center]
